info.name: Renamer
info.description: Edit MULTIPLE file names and metadata safely and fastly using rules (regex, replace, metadata-ready). Record your rules and presets for later use, share them with your team. Supports import/export, save / load of rules / plans of rules sets to reuse or share with community. PDF actions : PDF to CBZ conversion for comic books and manga (requires php-zip and pdfimages from poppler-utils). Metadata reading/writing for audio files (mp3, flac, ogg, opus, wav, m4a) using getID3 library and ffmpeg for M4A.
info.author: voualla
